user_clarification: use first training texture scheme with inherent indirect reflection allowed
background: only tex-table and tex-wall texture file replacement, original paired XML
policy_image_transform: same PIL processor.apply_transform on horizontal-flipped top-left render; no new center crop
success: env.check_success(), not reward or manual judgement
smoke: first state Clean A/B/C/D; included in160; no parameter changes
confidence: Wilson per cell descriptive; task/state paired cluster bootstrap for differences, seed20261022; no iid transition assumption
research_definition: 背景材质干预下的视觉鲁棒性
order: state_id ascending; clean A B C D, then background A B C D
invalid_rule: record INVALID, stop all remaining trials; no automatic retry; invalid excluded from SR, never count as failure

bootstrap.unit: resample five initial states with replacement within each of four fixed tasks, keeping all eight paired outcomes
bootstrap.limitations: conditional on these four tasks; not a new-task or training-seed CI
